captions.detailed: A simplified laboratory monocular microscope featuring a heavy, rounded black base and a vertical grey support column. A rectangular specimen stage is fixed to the column, while a beige optical body carriage sits above it. This carriage supports an inclined monocular eyepiece tube and a circular objective turret, and it is flanked by two black focus knobs. The optical body carriage slides vertically along the column for focusing, and the focus knobs rotate continuously about their shared horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a benchtop monocular laboratory microscope. It should feature a heavy black base, a vertical metallic column, a fixed black specimen stage, and a beige optical body carriage. The carriage must be able to translate vertically along the column, and it should include rotating focus knobs, an eyepiece tube, and an objective turret.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject structure. The base is constructed from a rounded Box primitive, supporting a vertical Cylinder column and a fixed specimen stage. The optical carriage is created as a separate part using Box and Cylinder primitives to form the main housing, inclined eyepiece, and objective turret. This carriage is connected to the base via a prismatic joint to allow vertical focusing motion. Finally, the focus knobs are modeled as cylinders connected to the carriage with a continuous rotational joint.
